#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

long long powMod(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss(line);
    long long n, m, l, r;
    ss >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    
    long long k = n * m;
    long long len = r - l + 1;
    const long long mod = 998244353LL;
    
    if (k % 2 == 1) {
        cout << powMod(len, k, mod) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    
    long long ans = (powMod(len, k, mod) + powMod(len % 2, k, mod)) * powMod(2, mod - 2, mod) % mod;
    cout << ans << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
